description: Escaped locator length vectors for binary extractors (plugin-protocol.md section 5.5.5). An extractor locator holds at most sent_limit characters as sent. The host percent-escapes it as lint-report.md describes, then checks the escaped length against escaped_limit, the bound of the report's origin.locator. A longer escaped form fails that document with extract-budget (-32010), data.budget locator and data.limit equal to escaped_limit, and the run exits 2. The host never truncates, and nothing invalid reaches the report. Each case builds the sent locator from parts, a list of [character, count] pairs. sent_chars and escaped_chars are worked out by hand: a percent sign becomes 3 characters, and U+2028 (3 UTF-8 bytes) becomes 9. A host replays the file; it has no Rust host path yet, so tests/contract/test_binary_locator_escape.py checks the vectors against a reference escaper and the report schema.
